rules.statement: Build a qualified, shot-ready GLB from the supplied DN80 CL2500 pneumatic cascade control-valve STEP assembly that serves professional commercial cinematography; preserve only geometry needed by the shots rather than reproducing every CAD or BOM instance.

children.statement: Acceptance must identify the visually inspected source, its provenance, the compatible tool or conversion path used, and any structures that remain unverified.
Acceptance must map every planned shot to geometry that is retained, merged, rebuilt, instanced, or deleted.

Acceptance must prove that the GLB exposes exactly six bounded semantic groups required for hero, actuator-to-stem motion, cascade-trim reveal, flow-path visualization, detail and grouped assembly actions.

rules.statement: Re-direct the exactly five-shot control-valve animatic around restrained industrial authority and product comprehension: preserve a stable external spatial anchor, use slow and monotonic camera motion with zero roll, reveal internals through shell transparency and modest semantic separation, prohibit blackout transitions and camera teleports, and finish with a stable product hero.

children.statement: Acceptance must provide deterministic camera, target, field-of-view, focus, part and light state for the canonical animatic timeline.
Acceptance must include rendered frame or video evidence showing that all required camera beats are legible and continuous.

Acceptance must prove every canonical frame has zero roll, negligible transition occlusion, no hidden camera relocation, bounded field-of-view change, and an external product or valve-body spatial anchor.

Acceptance must visually prove a coherent restrained-industrial direction through quieter type hierarchy, graphite and cool-steel surfaces, one copper focal accent, deliberate pacing and comprehension holds without presenting the direction as an undocumented corporate brand standard.

rules.statement: Bind component naming, mechanisms and commercial claims to the supplied STEP product tree and visually observed geometry; DN80, CL2500, pneumatic actuation, cascade trim and named components may be reported as source labels, but pressure performance, flow coefficient, sealing class, safety certification, service procedure and simulated fluid behavior must not be inferred.

children.statement: Acceptance must enumerate verified facts, visual inferences and unresolved product claims separately.

rules.statement: Exclude full BOM interaction, hundreds of independently animated fasteners, maintenance simulation, CFD, FEA and other digital-twin behavior from this commercial shot asset.
